thread:
maria.finance: Heads up — Feb invoice shows two identical 'Accelerator support (asia-east1)' line items for account redwood-prod, each ~12,300 USD. Not sure if this is a provider duplicate or our labels mapping. Can someone take a look?

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-02 processed: gs://redwood-billing/invoices/invoice_2026_02_redwood-prod.pdf :file_cabinet:

jordan.sre: :eyes: can you paste the invoice line_item ids or export? I'll run a quick check against the billing export.

maria.finance: here's the quick BQ extract (redacted ids) — two rows with the same SKU/description and amount: 

```
invoice_id, invoice_line_item_id, sku_description, region, amount_usd
INV-2026-02-01, LI-9a3f, Accelerator support (asia-east1), asia-east1, 12300.00
INV-2026-02-01, LI-b72d, Accelerator support (asia-east1), asia-east1, 12300.00
```

kevin.infra: Do we have both a Dedicated reservation support add-on and a separate "pool" support flag applied to the same accelerators? I remember we recently rolled out a support attachment for burst pools.

lina.billing: running a join now between billing_export.gcp_line_items and infra.reservations by resource_name + labels.

```sql
SELECT r.reservation_id, l.invoice_line_item_id, l.amount_usd, r.labels
FROM `billing_export.gcp_line_items` l
JOIN `infra.reservations` r ON l.resource_name = r.resource_name
WHERE l.sku_description LIKE '%Accelerator support%'
AND l.invoice_month = '2026-02'
LIMIT 20;
```

Query result: 
reservation_id, invoice_line_item_id, amount_usd, labels
r-123, LI-9a3f, 12300.00, {"support":"true","pool":"reserved"}
r-123, LI-b72d, 12300.00, {"support":"true","pool":"burst"}

jordan.sre: That matches my suspicion — same reservation_id mapping to two pools (reserved + burst) but both inherited the support label. The provider treats them as separate billable resources so billed support twice.

kevin.infra: Filed a case with the provider: case 11827345. Asking for reversal/credit for the duplicate support surcharge. Also adding a fix to our attach-support flow to dedupe when reservation_id already has support=true.

maria.finance: Can we get an estimated credit amount to record against Feb? If each line is 12,300 then expected credit ~12,300 USD (we don't yet assume both will be credited).

lina.billing: Added case link + expected credit to the billing tracker (sheet cell F42). Also running a detection query across the last 12 months to find any other reservation_ids that have >1 support charge in the same month.

```sql
-- find duplicate support charges per reservation per month
SELECT invoice_month, reservation_id, COUNT(*) as support_charges, SUM(amount_usd) as total_support_usd
FROM `billing_export.gcp_line_items`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%Accelerator support%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, reservation_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY invoice_month DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

jordan.sre: Temporary mitigation applied: patch that checks existing reservations before attaching support flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2546 — will be deployed to prod in the next deploy window.

maria.finance: Thanks — please keep finance looped for provider confirmation. Marking as awaiting provider credit. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Provider case update: case 11827345 — provider acknowledged duplicate charge and will issue credit on next invoice cycle. ETA 3-5 business days.

kevin.infra: :rocket: Closing loop on infra side. We'll monitor next invoice and escalate if credit doesn't appear. If provider declines, we'll capture the cost to our support-ops bucket and run retrospective billing adjustments.

maria.finance: Noted. I'll watch the March invoice and update accounting once credit posts. Thanks all.
